title: Explicit runtime model selection and truthful attribution
outcomes: Pass frozen model/effort to every native phase and fail closed before mutation on unsupported selections.

in: Codex model discovery, frozen phase profiles, enforced runtime options and factual usage attribution
out: Worker topology, active-task resume, release engine and workspace manager
boundaries: Native Codex process and declarative unsupported Hermes/custom adapters

decision_rights: Authorize execution and choose model; GO on 2026-09-13
Implement bounded contract choices and document compatibility behavior

constraints: No global default model or automatic escalation is introduced.
Project/task selection is explicit and immutable for a started run.
Opaque Hermes/custom commands remain valid for legacy tasks; controlled model execution fails closed until their adapter supports it.
Runtime settings and authoritative model confirmation are distinct; never infer the effective model from agent prose.

quality_attributes.scenario: Each controlled build, critic and repair phase
quality_attributes.measure: Phases missing selected runtime model/effort arguments

quality_attributes.scenario: Unknown model, incompatible effort, unsupported adapter or changed frozen selection
Adapter prose claims model usage without runtime confirmation
quality_attributes.measure: False effective confirmations or fabricated usage/cost values

risks: Runtime capability interfaces vary by installation; return an actionable unsupported result.
